passage.label: Moses said people why harm me while you know I am messenger Allah to you; when deviated Allah caused hearts deviate; Allah does not guide defiantly disobedient; Jesus son Mary said children Israel indeed I am messenger Allah confirming came before me Torah bringing good tidings messenger come after whose name Ahmad; when came clear evidences said obvious magic; who more unjust invents about Allah untruth while invited Islam; Allah does not guide wrongdoing; want extinguish light Allah mouths Allah perfect His light although disbelievers dislike; sent Messenger guidance religion truth manifest over all religion although associate others dislike

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ يَٰقَوۡمِ لِمَ تُؤۡذُونَنِي وَقَد تَّعۡلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوٓاْ أَزَاغَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ

وَإِذۡ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيۡكُم مُّصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرَۢا بِرَسُولٖ يَأۡتِي مِنۢ بَعۡدِي ٱسۡمُهُۥٓ أَحۡمَدُۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ
وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلۡإِسۡلَٰمِۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطۡفِـُٔواْ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَٱللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِۦ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلۡحَقِّ لِيُظۡهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكُونَ

mainSubject.label: Musa's complaint that his people harmed him despite knowing he was their messenger, with their deviation answered by Allah causing their hearts to deviate since He does not guide the defiantly disobedient; Isa son of Mary confirming the prior Torah and giving glad tidings of a messenger named Ahmad coming after him, met with the charge of obvious magic when clear evidences arrived; none more unjust than one fabricating against Allah while being invited to Islam, under the principle that He does not guide wrongdoers; their attempt to extinguish divine light with their mouths answered by Allah perfecting it despite their dislike; the Messenger sent with guidance and the religion of truth to prevail over all religion despite associators' displeasure

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the firm-rank imagery (4) before the Musa narrative opens (5); P2 ends with the religion-of-truth prevalence declaration (9) before the saving-trade offer begins (10); P3 runs from that offer through the victory promise, the hawariyyun dialogue and the closing dominance statement (10-14).
